# Define
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: establish one bounded delivery objective before routing to Design.

Establish the outcome, boundary, evidence, and decisions for one Lead Hub delivery cycle.

## Interface Contract

```text
User request or matic execution plan + approved project context -> define one bounded delivery objective -> cycle definition and define handoff
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | Declared project sources, user or issue request, and the matic selection or execution plan when this is a matic run |
| Transform | Establish one bounded delivery objective, acceptance result, evidence needs, and decisions |
| Outputs | Cycle definition, define handoff, run manifest, and run state |

## Inputs

| Source | File/Location | Section/Scope | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Repository identity | `../../../AGENTS.md` | Behavior and output rules | Governing instructions |
| Workspace routing | `../../CONTEXT.md` | Full file | Cycle and source routing |
| Project context | `../../../CONTEXT.md` | Status, folder map, task routing | Current project position |
| Product baseline | `../../../artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md` | Scope, requirements, exclusions, acceptance boundary | Approved product boundary |
| Delivery plan | `../../../artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-delivery-plan.md` | Technical plan, gates, fallback, responsibilities | Delivery constraints |
| Backlog | `../../../artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-backlog.md` | Work packages, backlog items, sequence | Work selection |
| Current controls | `../../../pm-control/registers/decision-log.md` and `change-log.md` | Current decisions and changes | Avoid stale direction |
| Workspace reference | `../../references/scope-and-boundaries.md` | Full file | Scope handling rules |
| Prior cycle | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/05-learn/what-now.md` | Full file | Continuation input, if present |
| User or IT input | User-provided source | Full file | New evidence or direction |
| Matic selection | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/01-select/issue-selection.md` | Conditional | Selected GitHub issue when this is a matic run |
| Matic plan | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/02-plan-control/execution-plan.md` | Conditional | Authorized issue boundary and acceptance plan |
| Run state | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | No | Resume context |

## Process

1. Confirm `{{OUTPUT_ROOT}}` and generate `{{RUN_SLUG}}`; show `{{RUN_PATH}}` before creating a run folder unless the matic label has authorized the deterministic path.
2. Create or update `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md` with the workspace, date, request, source paths, and prior run link. Preserve the matic selection and plan links when they already exist.
3. Read only the declared inputs and identify the current delivery objective.
4. Separate approved scope, evidence, assumptions, open decisions, blockers, and actions.
5. Define the smallest useful cycle, its acceptance result, and the human review point.
6. Record missing environment, ownership, access, content, or authority inputs without guessing.
7. Write `lead-lab-build-brief.md` and `define-handoff.md` to the stage run folder.
8. Update `run-state.md` when the stage completes, pauses, or blocks.

| Define handoff | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/01-define/define-handoff.md` | Markdown |
| Run manifest | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md` | Markdown |
| Run state | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | Markdown |

## Checkpoints

| After Step | Agent Presents | Human Decides |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Cycle objective, boundary, and acceptance result | Continue, narrow, or change the cycle |

## Input Gate

Stop when the request, approved boundary, required source, or matic execution plan is missing or contradictory. Do not infer scope or authority.

## Verify

- The objective is one bounded outcome.
- Every acceptance result has an evidence source.
- Open decisions, risks, and blockers are separated from confirmed facts.
- The handoff names the next stage and its required inputs.
